title: Aakar Price Breakdown v1
description: Computed by the API pricing module from a print estimate and a material. All amounts are integer paise (INR minor units). Snapshotted into cart and order so totals never drift.

label.description: Customer-facing, e.g. 'Material · 84 g' or 'Print time · 3 h 40 m'.

subtotal_paise.description: Sum of lines with margin applied and rounded to a price ending in 9 rupees.

family_id.description: Outcome family the piece belongs to, when known; drives hardware, setup and minimum rules.

minimum_subtotal_paise.description: Present when the family's minimum lifted the subtotal above the computed lines.
